text.p: The following are the leading stories in the Maltese press on Wednesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.

- General Workers' Union says it is against certain aspects of White Paper on new tax. The left-leaning union did not specify which aspects it opposes in the proposed system to replace value added tax, but has sent a memorandum to the government.

- The AX Group, owners of the Suncrest, Malta's biggest hotel, is selling 20 percent of its shares and issuing three million Maltese pounds (about $8 million) in bonds to finance other projects including the building of a further two hotels and further development of a private hospital.
- Nurses to get refunds after union pressure following controversy with the government after they received a reduced salary over problems on interpretation of a collective agreement.
- Funeral held for woman and man who tried to save her after she was swept by freak wave into sea at Selmun, 10 miles north of Valletta.
